name: Password reveal
summary: A button inside a password field that shows and hides what was typed.
description: Add it to every password field where people type a new or existing password, so they can check it before submitting. Without JS the button does nothing and the field stays a normal password input.

classes.name: v-password-toggle
classes.description: The toggle button. With two icons inside, aria-pressed decides which one shows.

states.description: Set by the JS while the password is visible; the second icon (eye-off) shows.
The input type while revealed. The caret stays where the person left it.

hooks.name: data-v-password
hooks.description: Wires the first button in the group to flip the first input between password and text.

keyboard.action: Moves from the input to the toggle.

a11y: Give the button a fixed name (aria-label="Show password"). aria-pressed carries the state; a name that changes with it would be read as "Hide password, pressed".
aria-controls on the button points at the input it reveals.
Both icons are aria-hidden, the button name does the talking.

examples.title: Password with reveal
examples.html: At least 12 characters.

examples.title: Revealed
examples.description: The state after pressing the button: text input, pressed button, eye-off icon.
